# SSH Key Generator

> Free, open-source browser tool for generating Ed25519 and RSA SSH key pairs, preparing ssh-keygen commands, and building SSH client configuration.

Canonical website: https://sshkeygenerator.com/
Reference reviewed against repository content: 2026-11-04.

## Tool

- [SSH Key Generator](https://sshkeygenerator.com/): Interactive tool for Ed25519, RSA 2048-bit, and RSA 4096-bit key generation, public/private key export, and SHA256 fingerprints. Includes command and SSH configuration helpers.

Key-generation code runs in the browser using Web Crypto and local cryptographic libraries. The application does not upload generated private keys or passphrases. The hosted website also uses analytics and advertising; browser-local key generation is not a security certification. For environments that require local terminal generation, use OpenSSH ssh-keygen and follow your organization's policy.

## SSH guides by task

- [What is SSH?](https://sshkeygenerator.com/what-is-ssh/): Understand Secure Shell, its transport and authentication, and common uses.
- [What is an SSH key?](https://sshkeygenerator.com/what-is-an-ssh-key/): Understand public and private keys, fingerprints, passphrases, and authentication.
- [Generate an SSH key](https://sshkeygenerator.com/generate-ssh-key/): Choose a browser or local terminal workflow and create a key pair.
- [ssh-keygen command reference](https://sshkeygenerator.com/ssh-keygen/): Use OpenSSH key-generation flags, file paths, passphrases, and fingerprint commands.
- [Set up SSH access](https://sshkeygenerator.com/how-to-set-up-ssh/): Install a public key, configure an SSH client, and test authentication.
- [ssh command examples](https://sshkeygenerator.com/ssh-command/): Connect to hosts using identity files, custom ports, tunnels, and jump hosts.
- [Check a VPS public IP](https://sshkeygenerator.com/check-vps-ip/): Check the source IP of an outbound request from an existing SSH session; understand NAT and proxy limitations.

## Project and policies

- [About](https://sshkeygenerator.com/about/): Project identity, implementation, and editorial corrections.
- [Contact](https://sshkeygenerator.com/contact/): Public GitHub issue tracker and reporting guidance. Never submit private keys or passphrases.
- [Privacy](https://sshkeygenerator.com/privacy/): Key material, stored browser preferences/configuration, hosting, analytics, and advertising.
- [Terms](https://sshkeygenerator.com/terms/): Tool and documentation usage terms.
- [Source code](https://github.com/Fechin/ssh-key-generator): MIT-licensed application repository.
- [Sitemap](https://sshkeygenerator.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical indexable pages and language alternatives.
